Egg whites: the pile covers roughly 60% of the plate and is fairly thick. I estimate about 150 g. Egg white is about 52 kcal per 100 g, so that comes to roughly 80 kcal. If it were cooked with oil or were whole egg, it would be higher, so I'll allow about 100 kcal.

Cantaloupe: I count about 8 chunks, roughly 80 g in total. At 34 kcal per 100 g, that is about 27 kcal.

Total weight is about 230 g and total energy is about 130 kcal.
